perlin2 — DRIVE terrain op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.perlin2(x, y, seed: 'int' = 0, freq: 'float' = 1.0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import driveterrain; driveterrain.perlin2(x, y, seed: 'int' = 0, freq: 'float' = 1.0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("perlin2"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Evaluates Perlin's (2002, improved noise) 2-D gradient noise at world coordinates (x, y).

The lattice has a spacing of freq [periods/m], gradients are unit vectors in 8 directions, interpolation is the quintic fade 6t⁵−15t⁴+10t³. Return value {"value", "dx", "dy"} (derivatives are analytic, d/dx is per world coordinate). Theorems: value 0 at lattice points, period of 256 lattice cells, |value| ≤ 1.
